verdict.rationale: Bland's MCP server explicitly lets AI coding agents/any AI agent operate the entire account—placing calls, building pathways, managing agents, querying analytics—via natural language, and this is the officially recommended way to connect an agent (bland-docs-11/20/27/34/44, bland-probe-3). This directly satisfies the natural-language-operation story beyond just an API/CLI. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the MCP server's natural-language reliability, and any real-world usage reports beyond first-party docs.
